### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d48931871479ccc303e10493e80799225b220038` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `5eb015585338e7ccc1bad3c097d93ffc504ea9a4` — the merge of head `cbce5d7831070cb1de797e8687ab7dbcea7b999f` into base `d48931871479ccc303e10493e80799225b220038`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 5eb015585338e7ccc1bad3c097d93ffc504ea9a4 && git checkout 5eb015585338e7ccc1bad3c097d93ffc504ea9a4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin d48931871479ccc303e10493e80799225b220038 cbce5d7831070cb1de797e8687ab7dbcea7b999f && git checkout -B drift-repro d48931871479ccc303e10493e80799225b220038 && git merge --no-ff cbce5d7831070cb1de797e8687ab7dbcea7b999f

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json d48931871479ccc303e10493e80799225b220038
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cbce5d7831070cb1de797e8687ab7dbcea7b999f`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #22780 (body; comments `6106434300` triage, `6109279475` re-entry, `6109384020` claim, `6109848334` os-dev-report); PR #22852 (body, 3-file list, net diff `origin/main...cbce5d78`, merge-base `31b5a5f7f5`); objectui#12119 body, its merge commit `29b99490`, its contract review `6106031964`; `.objectui-sha` on `main` and at the head, both `0df67f237c` (`29b99490` is its ancestor: exit 0, reverse control exit 1); objectui sources at that pin. Check-runs on the head: 35, 32 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`Build Docs`, `Console Pin Gate`, `Packed-tarball smoke`, path-filtered or opt-in), 0 failure or pending; all seven required contexts green (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Build Core`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`). Not a fork PR, no governed surface, 100 changed lines, still draft.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set unchanged — right.** The `.zod.ts` diff touches `guidance.field`, the `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` prescription string and two docblocks only; shape keys, aliases, the `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS` array and the `dependsOn` member are byte-identical. No export moves (`Type Check · source gates` green covers `check:api-surface`, `check:generated --reconcile-only`, `check:docs`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`); `Spec property liveness` green. No generated artifact carries any of the four sentences: a grep of the head tree for the old claim finds only `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` 17.5.0 and migration entry 18 (③).
- **The authored `bulkActionDefs[].params` `field` refusal still fires — right**, only its reason and remedy moved. The objectui pin agrees: `resolvePromotedBulkParams` returns an authored def by reference when `def.params` is an array (`resolveBulkActions.ts:202`), and `bulkParamToField` does no field lookup — so "an authored entry reaches the dialog as written" is true.
- **Promoted route at the pin, (a) — right.** `ObjectGrid.resolveDialogParams` (:5106-5116) awaits `metadata.ensureType('object')`, then `resolvePromotedBulkParams(def, ctx)`, which calls `resolveActionParams` imported from `@object-ui/fields` (`resolveBulkActions.ts:89-93, 197-212`) — the single-record dialog's resolver. The four param-path files are byte-identical at `29b99490`, the pin and `dca25aff2` (the dev's anchor), so the report's measurement transfers to the pin.
- **(b) The key list — right, key by key.** The resolver's field-backed output (`fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts:766-784`) inherits `type` (field.type), translated `label` (ctx.fieldLabel), `options` (normaliseOptions, labels through fieldOptionLabel), `required`, `placeholder`, `helpText` = field.help ?? field.description, `defaultValue`, `multiple`, `accept`, `maxSize`; for `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES` the `lookupExtras` block (:754-762) adds `referenceTo` (field.reference), `displayField`, `dependsOn`. `toBulkParam` (`resolveBulkActions.ts:155-176`) forwards exactly name, label, type, required, help, default, options, placeholder, multiple, object, labelField, dependsOn, accept, maxSize (plus the `unresolvedField` hand-off). Every key the prescription names arrives; nothing arrives that it omits. `FieldSchema` declares `description` and no `help` (`field.zod.ts:1146`), so "description (as the help text)" is the exact spec-side spelling; the dialog renders `param.help` under the control (`BulkActionDialog.tsx:799`) and seeds `default` (:150).
- **(c) — right.** `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField` are resolved (:757-761) and not forwarded by `toBulkParam`; so are the snake `id_field` / `title_format` reads (:756, :758).
- **(d) — right.** `FieldSchema` is `strictObject` (`field.zod.ts:1055`) with no `idField` member (the spec's only `idField` is `InlineGridColumnSchema`, :957); `authoring-key-lint.test.ts:163` pins `shapeKeys(FieldSchema)` without it, and `authoring-key-lint.ts:146` carries the `id_field` guidance. `idField` is refused with `unrecognized_keys`; the resolver reads only snake `id_field`. The docblock's parenthesis is true, and not calling `idField` "dropped" is right.
- **"the rest are never read off the field" — true.** `RuntimeField` (:348-429) declares none of min/max/step/precision/scale/rows/crop/capture/dimensions/defaultName/allowCreate/picker/subtitle/avatarField, and the output is built key by key with no spread of `field`.
- **"The promoted form runs the action once per selected record" — true at the pin.** `toBulkActionDef` emits `operation: 'custom'`, `actionDef`, `batchSize: 25`, no `execution` (:237-256); `useBulkExecutor` takes the non-aggregate branch and its `perRow` custom case calls `runAction(def, row, params)` per id (:306-335); `ObjectGrid.runBulkActionRecord` is one `executeAction` per row (:5163-5189), after the def's `visible` partition (:5128). Same semantics the file's own docblock (:340-343) and the superRefine message already state. The dev's added sentence is accepted.
- **"reaches this dialog only through a PROMOTED action ... named in the view's `bulkActions`" — true for the pinned door, narrower than source by one unpinned door.** An authored `execution: 'aggregate'` def that names a declared action and authors no `params` gets the same `toBulkActionDef` promotion merged under it (:442-458) and `resolvePromotedBulkParams` then resolves its field-backed params (:202). A claim as narrow as the pinned enforcement (Prime Directive #10 corollary), disclosed by the dev; ③ finding 4.
- **`dependsOn` docblock — true.** `dependsOn` is inherited only inside `lookupExtras` (reference-bearing types) and forwarded by `toBulkParam`; "a reference-bearing field's `dependsOn`" is the exact bound. "An AUTHORED def has no such route" true (:202).
- **Head vs pin.** The head's `.objectui-sha` equals `main`'s (`0df67f237c`), so every sentence true at the pin is true at the head. At the card's base (`e84aeb36c`, pin `20c6d351ad`) the old sentences were true — the hold and the re-entry were both right.
- **Docblock citation "Measured on objectui `main` `dca25aff2`" — a reading, and it transfers**: the pin is an ancestor of `dca25aff2` and the resolver, adapter, dialog and `resolveBulkActions.ts` are identical between them.
- **Unchanged neighbours still true at the pin**: the module header's "converter for the PROMOTED direction (`toBulkParam`)" and the alias comment "`toBulkParam` maps the same three" (`resolveBulkActions.ts:164-170` still renames helpText/defaultValue/referenceTo/displayField); the `objectOverride` guidance ("A bulk param is always inline") is about this authored shape and holds.
- **Pins re-pointed — right, they pin subjects.** `:70-85`: the closed-backtick `bulkActions` token matches "named in the view's `bulkActions`." in the prescription, and the `accept` / `maxSize` pair appears twice there; the route and the two keys are the sentence's subjects, and the one-prescription count pin (:435-439) still holds on "widget-config keys like". `:420-429`: no rename arrow for `field`, the backticked `object` (the inline remedy's picker target) and the open-backtick `bulkActions` prefix (matches the `bulkActions:` list literal). `object` alone would be a weak substring, but for `{ field: 'owner' }` only the `field` guidance fires (the `objectOverride` guidance, which also says `object`, does not), and paired with the other two assertions the case pins both remedies. The report's reverse verification (base text restored: 2 failed / 37 passed, exactly these two) is consistent.
- **Refusal text pinned by a consumer or test**: spec `bulk-action.test.ts` :83-84 and :423-428, both in this diff. cli: none — `migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` holds each printed block read from the registry at run time and lists `ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused` at :300 as a roster id, not a text pin. objectui at the pin: none — `BulkActionDialog.tsx:690` restates the authored-def refusal in a comment; the two spec-parity tests parse only.
- **Runtime strings carry no tracker number** (`Lint & Repo Gates` green); the bracketed action-name placeholder inside the `bulkActions` list literal is the pattern the file already uses at :114 and :428.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/22780-bulk-param-promoted-route-guidance.md`: `@objectstack/spec: patch`, body carries `Clause-②: no`, no ADR-0087 marker (none owed: nothing removed or renamed). `Check Changeset` green.
- The diff publishes two reworded runtime refusal strings, two docblocks and two test pins: no accept-set move, no export move, no `.describe()` change, no generated reference page moves. **Patch — right** (a fix to shipped text in a released package takes `patch`, never none). **`Clause-②: no` — right**, no arm; the claim's line "no (describe and guidance text only; the accept set does not move)" right, with one precision: the diff moves guidance and prescription strings plus docblocks, not a `.describe()`, which is why `check:docs` reports nothing. The changeset body's list of what the promoted route carries is the prescription's list, verified above.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none declared.

Deviations, each answered:
1. Model-free commit trailers and the session-URL PR footer — accepted: all three branch commits carry `Claude-Session` plus `Co-authored-by: Claude` (read off the branch), the form AGENTS.md requires; the harness reminder does not override it.
2. `origin/main` moved after the merge — accepted, with a correction: at review time `main` is four commits past the merge-base (`8c105e3d67`, `d489318714`, `8558668a68`, `12b9daf749`), not two; `12b9daf749` touches 13 `packages/spec` files (automation value slots and migration entry `18.flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused`) but none of this PR's three files or `bulk-action.*`; the queue leg rebuilds on current `main`.
3. The added "runs once per selected record" sentence — accepted, true at the pin (①).

Out-of-scope findings, each answered or escalated:
1. **Migration entry 18 — measured false at the pin, carrier: a NEW CARD.** `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused.ts` `replacement` (:25-26, "field-backed ACTION-param contracts the bulk surface does not implement") and `reason` (:53-55, "the bulk surface has no field-backed param route, so that value does not reach this dialog either") are false for the promoted route: the first as a blanket statement (true of the authored-def surface the entry governs), the second for `accept` / `maxSize` on a promoted def (true for every other refused key). Identical on `main`, untouched here. Carriers: `registry.ts` (gitignored, regenerated on install, build, test and typecheck), `spec-changes.json` (no committed copy; CI generates in memory), the upgrade guide (`docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md` is tracked but renders no entry-18 text; spec is 17.7.0, major 18 unshipped) and the `objectstack migrate meta` printout (the cli guidance test holds each block from the registry and refuses tracker numbers; no literal pin). So the fix is text-only in one file with no regeneration commit; the gate family the dev names runs on every PR regardless. Why not a patch round here: the claim's file surface names `bulk-action.zod.ts`, its references, its pins and one changeset with "stop on breach", the dev honoured it, and a review of record does not widen a dispatched claim after the fact; the entry is ADR-0087 D3 release-text with a different reader (an upgrader replaying 17 → 18) and its own acceptance criterion (the printed block); it is cheap and unhurried before major 18 ships. Draft for the seat to file, unassigned:
   - Title: spec: migration entry `ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused` says the bulk surface has no field-backed param route, but the console pin carries objectui `29b99490`
   - Body: Filing gate ①: a metadata-authoring trap in shipped guidance text, carried forward from #22780 (PR #22852), whose contract review found the same claim outside that card's file surface. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused.ts` says in `replacement` (about :25-26) that `field` / `objectOverride` are "field-backed ACTION-param contracts the bulk surface does not implement", and in `reason` (about :53-55) "do not answer it by declaring the key on the object's FIELD: the bulk surface has no field-backed param route, so that value does not reach this dialog either". Since objectui#12119 (`29b99490`, carried by `.objectui-sha` `0df67f237c`) a PROMOTED bulk action, an action the object declares named in the view's `bulkActions`, resolves its field-backed params through the single-record dialog's resolver, and of the refused widget-config keys `accept` / `maxSize` arrive from the field that way; `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField` are resolved and dropped, the rest are never read. The entry is printed by `objectstack migrate meta` (cli `migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts` holds each block verbatim and refuses tracker numbers) and projected into `registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json` and the upgrade guide at generation time, none committed, so the fix is text-only in that one file with no regeneration commit: reword the two sentences to say the authored `bulkActionDefs[].params` surface has no such route, and name the promoted route and the two keys, in the wording PR #22852 landed in `bulk-action.zod.ts`. Spec is at 17.7.0, so the text has not shipped in a major-18 tarball; `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` 17.5.0 carries the same sentence and stays as shipped (release-owned, true when written). `Clause-②: no`. Dedupe: `ui-bulk-action-param-unknown-keys-refused field-backed`; `bulk surface has no field-backed param route migration`; `promoted bulk action field-backed migrate meta guidance`.
2. **CHANGELOG 17.5.0 (:8679, :8689) — "historical record, not an erratum" confirmed.** The sentence was true when 17.5.0 shipped (objectui `29b99490` merged 2026-10-11 and reached the pin through #22812 the same day); AGENTS.md's docs-only amendment route is for an entry that was wrong when released, and the next entry, compiled from this changeset at version time, records the change through the ordinary channel. No edit owed.
3. **The bulk adapter drops the lookup settings** — already escalated to the objectui `domain:ui` seat at `6106031964` finding 1; the spec prescription now states the gap, which is what that review asked of the objectstack follow-up. No objectstack card; the card-or-fold answer is still owed on the objectui side. Noted.
4. **The aggregate-def door** (an authored `execution: 'aggregate'` def naming a declared action with no authored `params` resolves field-backed params too) — accepted as a claim narrower than the pinned enforcement; the door is unpinned in objectui (`bulkFieldBackedParam-12105.test.tsx` pins the `bulkActions` door only). The carrier the dev names ("whoever next touches `resolvePromotedBulkParams`") is not a card: escalated to the objectui `domain:ui` seat as a one-line rider on finding 3's card, pin that door or leave it unnamed; the spec text widens only after a pin.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22780-bulk-promoted-route-text`
Reviewed-by: `session_016njDy8ozy9B9Ns5Y8kAWEK`

**VERDICT: PASS**
